title: National Challenge 1
wikitext:
== Introduction ==
On 13th of April [[1997]] a national challenge between [[Finland]] and [[Sweden]] took place. All 15 players from each team were present as the match format was set to be 15 vs 15. Sweden won the first game 742-456 and the second game 695-436.
 
== Results ==
* 1st - [[Image:flag_se.gif]] [[Sweden]]
* 2nd - [[Image:flag_fi.gif]] [[Finland]]

== Lineups ==

* '''Sweden''' - [[NerdKiller]], [[oKKun]], [[DOOMer]], [[McCoy]], [[iTChiBan]], [[jesper]], [[Nator]], [[HonK]], [[Joe_Dalton]], [[hitman]], [[kemiKal]], [[Hjoerdis]], [[Mr. Kill]], [[El_Loco]], [[Cutter]]
* '''Finland''' - [[Axu]], [[Fang]], [[flu]], [[Lunatic]], [[Jazzoman]], [[Perkele]], [[Judge]], [[AE_Rive]], [[Demonic]], [[kaapeli]], [[Simply]], [[zibbo]], [[Vortex]], [[Hammer]], [[Zatanic]]
